card.name: Digits inside DOIs and dates
card.fires_on: Digits inside a journal DOI such as 10.1097/MOU, and similar spots in citations, years and table numbers. Also a few words in fixed web-page phrases like 'To learn more visit Healthwise'.

modes.description: Single digits within the numeric part of a journal DOI in a citation.

modes.description: Digits in review dates, copyright years or after the word Table.
